title: EVA landing sections 1 to 5 visual proposal project plan
status: Detailed plan for a separate review experience

scope.deliverable: An interactive, scroll-led visual proposal for Hero, Three easy steps, Results, Panel scope, and Ongoing value, with a detailed copy-to-design handoff.
scope.publication: Publish a separate review route on the existing EVA content-review Site. Root preserves the existing audience and owns all source credentials, integration and deployment.
scope.unchanged: Sections6–9 remain available for a later review. Do not silently replace the homepage or activate real orders, uploads, account changes or health-data collection.
scope.languages: English is the review priority. Keep copy structured for translation and preserve existing Spanish routes.

price.rule: Do not assume a VAT rate, tax exemption, gross price, discount, or automatic billing promise.

audience.description: People starting testing and preventive health
audience.conversionJob: Make the first test understandable and worthwhile
audience.retentionJob: Help them learn what a baseline means and why a later reading can be useful

audience.conversionJob: Show what EVA adds to existing reports and repeat testing
audience.retentionJob: Give guided ownership of what to measure next, with scope, eligibility and price made clear

confirmedFacts.choice: Quarterly panel choice with guidance is an approved direction. It does not mean every alternative panel is included in the base kit price.
confirmedFacts.visualContinuity: Preserve the established EVA photography, luminous/dot treatment, cinematic scroll narrative, and approved three-step collection film.

sectionContract.name: Hero
sectionContract.visitorQuestion: What does EVA do, and where do I fit?
sectionContract.beginnerMessage: A clear starting point for understanding blood results.
sectionContract.experiencedMessage: More meaning from your results and a guided next measurement.
sectionContract.copyJob: Name at-home testing, explanation and continuity immediately. Keep the commercial line at 13 biomarkers and €99 + VAT.
sectionContract.designJob: Existing cinematic runner and readable solid text; a discreet two-audience choice may change supporting copy without rebuilding the page.
sectionContract.handoff: One primary journey with a visible secondary existing-results route; no implied completed purchase from a review button.
sectionContract.reviewGate: A first-time reviewer can identify the service, audience route, kit size and net price without completing an animation.

sectionContract.name: Three easy steps
sectionContract.visitorQuestion: How much effort does this take?
sectionContract.experiencedMessage: Collection logistics do not add unnecessary effort.
sectionContract.copyJob: Collect at home; return in the prepaid envelope; open explained results. Keep virtually painless and no needles to handle, rather than an absolute pain guarantee.
sectionContract.designJob: Approved native-speed film inside an unclipped frame. Scrolling reveals surrounding copy, while Previous, Next and Pause remain real controls.
sectionContract.reviewGate: All three steps remain available without watching the entire film; no scroll-seeking video playback, frozen frame transition, or screen overlay drift is introduced.

sectionContract.name: Results demonstration
sectionContract.visitorQuestion: What do I actually receive and learn?
sectionContract.beginnerMessage: A reading includes a value, its meaning and the questions worth understanding.
sectionContract.experiencedMessage: Compare like-for-like measurements and maintain context across readings.
sectionContract.copyJob: Explain one supported marker plainly before adding trend/context. Mark sample data. Do not infer a diagnosis, guaranteed improvement or a cause from a change.
sectionContract.designJob: Use the existing EVA dashboard's visual language or real interface capture. Reveal a measurement, explanation and history in that order.
sectionContract.reviewGate: Every shown core-kit marker belongs to the exact13. Units, names and illustrative status are consistent. Biological age and longevity scores are not presented as confirmed kit entitlements.

sectionContract.name: Panel scope
sectionContract.visitorQuestion: What is in this kit, and what can it help me explore?
sectionContract.beginnerMessage: A readable set of measurements with plain descriptions.
sectionContract.experiencedMessage: The exact current panel is transparent and distinct from future testing options.
sectionContract.copyJob: List all13 once. Group for comprehension only, with qualified educational descriptions. Fructosamine is not HbA1c; lipid measurements are not a complete cardiovascular diagnosis.
sectionContract.designJob: A quiet editorial index with expandable explanations or category highlighting, rather than13 competing animated cards.
sectionContract.reviewGate: Count and names match the supplied list exactly; no ApoB, insulin, HbA1c, vitamin D, ferritin, hormone panel or broader catalogue is included by implication.

sectionContract.name: Ongoing value
sectionContract.visitorQuestion: Why return, and who decides what I measure next?
sectionContract.beginnerMessage: Start with a baseline, understand the reading, then decide the next useful question.
sectionContract.experiencedMessage: Bring your history and choose the next panel with guidance.
sectionContract.copyJob: Distinguish baseline, comparison and guided choice. Explain ownership without suggesting unlimited testing, universal medical necessity or that all swaps cost the same.
sectionContract.designJob: A continuous timeline moving from first reading to comparison to a guided choice. Use the same result design, not a new product metaphor.
sectionContract.reviewGate: The two audiences can recognize their next action. Core kit, future panel choices and existing-report upload remain distinguishable.

phases.name: Freeze the offer and story
inputs: Existing review plan and current landing
outputs: One factual content contract
Five-section question-to-message map
Explicit proposal scope and remaining commercial questions
phases.gate: Confirmed facts are used directly; previously open15-marker panel facts are superseded within the proposal.

phases.name: Create the copy
inputs: Existing EVA voice and accepted film
outputs: Headline, support, action and short explanation for each section
Beginner and experienced variants where necessary
Claim ledger linking every measurement or service promise to a fact or a clearly labelled proposal
phases.gate: Plain-language explanation comes before technical detail; no fear statistic, fabricated benefit, unsupported score entitlement, or hidden commercial condition.

phases.name: Translate copy into design direction
inputs: Approved narrative and PhaseB copy hierarchy
outputs: Desktop and mobile art direction
Section layouts and transitions
Asset reuse and optional image-generation briefs
Reduced-motion and interaction rules
phases.dependency: B; asset and style inventory can start while copy is drafted
phases.gate: Every visual advances a copy objective. No animation hides the proposition, price or marker scope. Both audiences share one coherent brand and story.

phases.name: Build the review experience
outputs: Separate review route
Responsive scroll reveals
Native-speed approved film
Real interface example and precise marker index
Review link and supporting detailed plan
phases.gate: The proposal can be reviewed end-to-end with normal scrolling, keyboard, touch and reduced motion. Existing homepage and unrelated routes retain their current behavior.

phases.name: Judge and refine
phases.owner: Master project manager with copy and design reviewers
outputs: One consolidated issue list with owner and severity
Corrections in the relevant copy or design stage
Acceptance record
phases.gate: Resolve all factual and usability blockers. Limit polish loops to observed issues, with at most two correction passes before presenting any remaining trade-off clearly.

phases.name: Publish and hand over
inputs: Exact pushed source and build archive
outputs: Published review URL
Detailed plan with final copy, rationale and remaining decisions
Summary distinguishing published proposal from the unchanged main landing
phases.gate: Native deployment reports success; read back the saved plan. The user receives one obvious review link.

toolPlan.purpose: Implement the section story, audience variants, readable hierarchy and scroll transitions
toolPlan.constraint: Prefer transform/opacity and IntersectionObserver; avoid new frameworks, heavy scroll event rerenders and scroll-gated information.

toolPlan.tool: Approved runner, Tasso film and existing photographic assets
toolPlan.purpose: Preserve the accepted visual language and hardware accuracy
toolPlan.constraint: Do not regenerate the Tasso device or approved footage merely to create novelty.

toolPlan.purpose: Optional supporting atmospheric/data artwork if the designer identifies a gap
toolPlan.constraint: Generate only a specifically briefed asset. Do not synthesize UI text, medical proof, patient testimonials or inaccurate hardware.

toolPlan.tool: Existing dashboard components or authorized captures
toolPlan.purpose: Make the result presentation recognizably EVA
toolPlan.constraint: Do not copy old fixture scores or markers into a new13-marker entitlement.

toolPlan.purpose: Check desktop, phone, touch controls, overflow, playback and reduced motion
toolPlan.constraint: Evidence must describe the actual build; do not claim a real customer comprehension test was performed.

toolPlan.purpose: Save the detailed review plan and copy/design rationale
toolPlan.constraint: Update the selected plan with current facts and preserve unrelated future sections.
Root handles credentials, access checks, source synchronization and publication. No new subscription or generation spend is required for the proposal.

factual: €99 + VAT displayed transparently without an invented gross total
No15-marker or60-results-per-year claim in the proposed five sections
No unsupported full panel, score, AI advice, diagnosis or inclusive-swap promise
copy: Every section answers a new question
Both audiences can see their route and ongoing value
First-level text is readable without knowing biomarker terminology
Education links measurements to understanding, rather than promising health outcomes
design: Established warm-paper, ink, luminous photographic/dot identity
No type or price hidden beneath imagery
One continuous visual narrative across all five sections
Use the correct physical Tasso proportions and real EVA interface language
behavior: Normal-speed video; scrolling controls visibility rather than time
Previous, Next and Pause work with mouse, keyboard and touch
Desktop and phone avoid horizontal overflow or clipped video/copy
Reduced motion preserves all substantive content
No real order, upload, payment or health record is submitted
laterProduction: Confirm the customer-payable VAT-inclusive total and checkout presentation
Validate real order/fulfilment and results/support workflows
Resolve specialist-panel availability, pricing and rules before a customer can choose
Conduct brief comprehension checks with unbriefed people from each audience; treat this as future research rather than completed evidence

remainingDecisions.item: Applicable VAT and final checkout total
remainingDecisions.treatment: Keep the proposal at the user-confirmed €99 + VAT; resolve the payable total before production ordering.

remainingDecisions.item: Price unit, renewal and annual billing mechanics
remainingDecisions.treatment: Do not invent an automatic renewal or annual discount from the quarterly narrative.

remainingDecisions.item: Future quarterly panel catalogue and guidance
remainingDecisions.treatment: Show guided choice as the service direction. Keep unavailable or unpriced choices out of executable purchase controls.

remainingDecisions.item: Which dashboard outputs are supported by these13 inputs
remainingDecisions.treatment: Show supported measurements, explanation and history. Do not sell score eligibility until validated.

remainingDecisions.item: Laboratory timing, sample handling, geography and support
remainingDecisions.treatment: Preserve confirmed operational facts and separate laboratory turnaround from delivery and return transit.

completionDefinition: The user can open a separate, visually complete five-section proposal, understand both audience journeys and the13-marker €99 + VAT offer, inspect precise draft copy and design rationale, and choose refinements without the main landing page being silently replaced.
